title: Apple says proposed tariffs to hit a range of products
text:
All Forums Apple says proposed tariffs to hit a range of products
(Reuters) – Apple Inc ( AAPL.O ) said on Friday the proposed tariffs by President Donald Trump covers a wide range of its products, including Apple Watch and AirPods, but did not name iPhones.
People visit an Apple store in Istanbul, Turkey August 15, 2018. REUTERS/Murad Sezer/File Photo
“Our concern with these tariffs is that the U.S. will be hardest hit, and that will result in lower U.S. growth and competitiveness and higher prices for U.S. consumers,” the company said in a letter to the U.S. government.
Shares of the iPhone maker slipped 1 percent in extended trading. Reporting by Laharee Chatterjee in Bengaluru; Editing by Anil D’Silva
